question.text:
Consider the above sequence of reactions. 151 g of 2-bromopentane is made to react. Yield of major product P is $80 \%$ whereas Q is $100 \%$.
Mass of product Q obtained is ____ g.
(Given molar mass in $\mathrm{g} \mathrm{mol}^{-1} \mathrm{H}: 1, \mathrm{C}: 12, \mathrm{O}: 16$, $\mathrm{Br}: 80)$

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & \text { Molecular mass of } \mathrm{Q}=230 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \\ & \begin{aligned} \text { Mass of } \mathrm{Q} & =0.8 \times 230 \\ & =184 \mathrm{~g}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}$
